title: A tangent plane of multiplicity θ at x forces Θ^n(μ_V, x) = θ
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^N, V an n-varifold on U (Varifold N n U), x ∈ ℝ^N, T ∈ G(N,n) and θ ∈ ℝ with HasTangentPlane V x T θ (Simon Ch. 8, Def. 1.1). Then the n-dimensional density of μ_V = V.weight at x exists and equals θ: densityRatio n μ_V x ρ = μ_V(B_ρ(x))/(ω_n ρ^n) → ofReal θ as ρ → 0 within (0, ∞), with B_ρ(x) the closed ball and ω_n = unitBallVolume n. That is, HasDensity n V.weight x (ENNReal.ofReal θ).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ → HasDensity n V.weight x (ENNReal.ofReal θ)
